data.title: 史尔特尔 · 甜品店的口味选择
data.description: 【史尔特尔 · 甜品店的口味选择】街角甜品店里，史尔特尔穿着灰色卫衣与炭灰百褶裙，斜挎小包，站在冰淇淋展示柜前逐一看着口味牌。她一手扶住包带，另一手指向香草口味，语气比平时耐心得多——「就这个。别把旁边的坚果混进去，我要先尝原来的味道。」
data.action: 站在展示柜前，一手扶包带，另一手指向香草口味牌
data.promptProse: At the ice-cream display, Surtr keeps one hand on her crossbody-bag strap and points to vanilla with the other. Her oatmeal-gray hoodie and charcoal pleated skirt stand beside the glass cabinet in the side-on medium view. Flavor tubs step back under the counter. Afternoon window light illuminates her pointing fingers and the pale ice cream, leaving softened reflections across the display front.
data.camera: medium shot, side view of the display case and the pointing hand
